name: math.complex
doc:
math.complex (Go's complex128 + math/cmplx): Complex{Re, Im} with
arithmetic methods (Add, Sub, Mul, Div, Neg: the operator-interface
names, so `+ - * /` can map onto them once operator overloading lands)
and the cmplx functions.

items.name: Conj
items.doc: Conj returns the complex conjugate of c.
items.summary: Conj returns the complex conjugate of c.

items.doc: True if either part is NaN and neither is infinite.
